text:
ana (ml): heads-up 1: thalos13b int4 onboard is flapping under long-convo traffic. OOMs show up in steady-state after ~8-12k cumulative session tokens.
dev (infra): can you paste the minimal repro + config? microbatch vs batch? prefetch setting?
ana (ml): repro below. happens reliably when history grows.
```
model: thalos13b
quant: int4
batch_size: 6
max_new_tokens: 1024
prefetch: aggressive
```
rahul (runtime): that pattern screams freelist fragmentation from heavy KV prefetch + deep KV chains. int4 reduces tensor sizes but increases allocation churn (more small allocations). two quick experiments: 1) make prefetch lazy / skip for deep sessions, 2) add a small slot reserve (reserve_ratio=0.04), 3) start a low-priority slot compactor to reclaim fragmented slabs. also collect freelist_fragmentation_pct.
kai (prodex): agree run a canary with conservative defaults and an A/B for quality (int4-only vs int8-fallback). we need console messaging if we change hosted defaults.
deploy-bot: rolling out canary -> hosts: gpu-811,gpu-822 (tag: canary/thalos13b/2026-04-12).
rahul (runtime): on canary flip runtime flags: prefetch.lazy=true, prefetch.skip_threshold=4000, reserve_ratio=0.04, kv_eviction_threshold=0.72, kv_prefetch_shrink=true, compactor.qos=low (interval=60s). add probe kernel_colocation_score and freelist_fragmentation_pct to telemetry.
dev (infra): flags applied to canary. added dashboard panels and alert at freelist_fragmentation_pct>12% sustained 10m.
nana (ml): baseline (before): p95=440ms, rss_peak=23.8GB, failure_rate(OOM+alloc)=1.2% on our long-convo set (200 sessions, avg history 9k).
ana (ml): 45m snapshot on canary: failure_rate=0.10%, p95 +30ms, rss -380MB, freelist_fragmentation_pct down from ~18% to ~6%.
kai (prodex): what's the EM delta on QA? int4-only vs int8-fallback?
nana (ml): quick A/B: int4-only = -0.7% EM. with auto-fallback to int8 for sessions >16k tokens EM gap reduces to -0.12%. runway looks safe.
rahul (runtime): recommendation for hosted defaults (thalos13b/int4): prefetch=lazy, default_batch=4, max_new_tokens=512, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, kv_prefetch_shrink=true, reserve_ratio=0.04, compactor.qos=low interval=60s. add auto-fallback to int8 when session_tokens>16k and a session-level prefetch backoff when eviction_count>3 in 5m. add soft latency penalty when eviction fires to avoid oscillation.
dev (infra): will gate the default flip behind a feature flag, schedule 24h canary, and add per-customer routing to Dedicated for pinned high-token requests. also adding kernel_colocation isolation if score>0.7.
kai (prodex): I'll draft release notes & console tooltip: "thalos13b int4 tuned defaults for long-convo stability. For >1k token jobs use Dedicated or Reserved capacity." include rollback triggers: EM delta >1% or unexplained OOMs.
nana (ml): ML action: export full eval CSV after 24h and run regression checks. if EM regression >1% we revert fallback sooner.
ops-bot: canary update: 0 OOMs in last 60m on canary hosts.
rahul (runtime): one more improvement: enable per-session compaction hint for sessions predicted to go long (predicted_tail>6k) so compactor prioritizes them. also instrument `freelist_fragmentation_pct` alongside `slab_free_runaway` for better root cause signals.
dev (infra): compaction hint metric added to canary telemetry. alerting rules updated.
nana (ml): thanks team. TL;DR: root cause isolated to aggressive prefetch + int4 + deep KV chains; mitigations (lazy/skip prefetch, small reserve, compactor, kv_prefetch_shrink, lower max_new_tokens default, auto-fallback to int8) show solid improvement in canary. will post full metrics + eval CSV after 24h. :thumbsup:
